name: 逸侠世界
group_note: 逸俠之世界 (Daniel's World), ES II lineage, Taiwan-origin (BBS 140.127.179.161, contact leonguo@tpts4.seed.net.tw). MAJOR encoding bug found and fixed before any WASM-specific work: this archive is BIG5-encoded, but the initial convert_lib.sh pass (which hard-codes GB18030 as the source encoding) round-tripped every string through the WRONG codepage -- the result was valid UTF-8 that decoded to real-but-nonsense CJK characters (e.g. write("\u7729\u7420\u3085") instead of "\u60a8\u7684\u82f1\u6587") rather than an iconv error, so it looked converted but every player-facing message was mojibake. Confirmed by decoding a raw .c file with both codecs and comparing a write() string literal. Extended scripts/convert_lib.sh with an optional third 'source-encoding' argument (defaults to GB18030, unchanged for every other lib) and re-ran this lib's conversion with BIG5 -- all prior source-level WASM fixes (which were applied to the GB18030-mojibake tree) had to be redone against the freshly-BIG5-converted tree, since convert_lib.sh deletes and recreates work/ from raw/. WASM-specific fixes applied: (1) classic §8.1 GBK byte-range is_chinese()/check_legal_name() (parity gate, [i..<0] suffix slice, byte-doubled 2/12 bounds) fixed to per-codepoint 0x4e00-0x9fff and name[i..i], bounds halved to 1/6. (2) §7.12 tell_room() bare-exclude message() crash fixed with the standard exclude || ({}) guard. (3) master.lpc's valid_write() (valid_read() already unconditionally returns 1) got the standard 'user == this_object()' short-circuit. (4) §7.50 is_killing(object) vs is_killing(string id) fixed at 9 call sites (kungfu class roar/nuke files, several u/d/daniel/ NPC files, cmds/std/surrender.lpc). (5) 39 CRLF .o save files under data/ normalized to LF (restore_object() can choke on \r inside nested mappings). (6) GENUINE bug, not WASM-specific: adm/daemons/securityd.lpc's valid_write() checked 'file == user->query_save_file()' with exact string equality for the save_object() fast-path, but this driver's save_object() efun (vm/internal/base/object.cc) appends __SAVE_EXTENSION__ (.o) to the filename before invoking valid_write() -- the exact-match always failed, so save_object() was denied on EVERY player save (registration, world entry, quit), throwing 'Denied write permission in save_object()' every time. Fixed by comparing against query_save_file() + __SAVE_EXTENSION__ (matching the already-correct pattern found in this session's yhwhpublicfi/yxjh sibling libs -- yxsj's securityd.lpc was simply missing it). adm/daemons/ftpd.lpc and adm/daemons/network/dns_master.lpc are both dormant (commented out of adm/etc/preload, only guarded wizard-command callers) and were left untouched. Known non-blocking issues, not chased down further: adm/daemons/chinesed.lpc and adm/daemons/emoted.lpc both throw a caught, non-fatal 'Illegal mapping format while restoring dict/emote' at boot (same unexplained restore_object() failure signature seen on a different lib -- yxjh's named.lpc -- with different content, so likely a shared driver quirk rather than lib-specific corruption; degrades nothing observed in play). A transient 'apply() with insufficient permission... needs: private, has: hidden' for obj/user's command_hook appears during registration/login but does not block command processing, world entry, or quit. Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist ((admin) is this lib's top tier). Registration verified end-to-end pre- and post-formatter (English id -> y confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> email -> gender -> enters 士林高中/school gate area), admin permission confirmed via '目前權限﹕(admin)'. LPC formatter run across all 949 .lpc files (919 written, 21 pre-existing errors, 9 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates, no CJK-respacing/broken-escape hits.
